name: redstart
description: Local LLM host and launcher — wraps llama.cpp/TurboQuant into a managed server with multi-device network access, chat UI, and coding agent support.
author: Patrick Carswell

scripts.dev: concurrently "vite" "npm --prefix src/chat-ui run dev:redstart" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:chat && node scripts/make-icon.mjs && vite build && npm run license:gen && electron-builder
scripts.test:security: node scripts/test-ci-parity.mjs && node scripts/test-path-scope.mjs && node scripts/test-conversation-isolation.mjs && node scripts/test-file-isolation.mjs && node scripts/test-tool-policy.mjs && node scripts/test-roles.mjs && node scripts/test-tool-namespacing.mjs && node scripts/test-user-scope.mjs && node scripts/test-system-prompt.mjs && node scripts/test-llama-args.mjs && node scripts/test-model-download.mjs && node scripts/test-network-binding.mjs && node scripts/test-web-fetch-ssrf.mjs && node scripts/test-external-mcp-url.mjs && node scripts/test-json-store.mjs && node scripts/test-logging.mjs && node scripts/test-discovery-robustness.mjs && node scripts/test-net-interfaces.mjs && node scripts/test-packaging.mjs && node scripts/test-auth.mjs && node scripts/test-gateway-routes.mjs && node scripts/test-ipc-contract.mjs && node scripts/test-ipc-guard.mjs && node scripts/test-mcp-capabilities.mjs && node scripts/test-provider-conformance.mjs && node scripts/test-contracts.mjs && node scripts/test-connector-contract.mjs && npm --prefix src/chat-ui run test:security
